answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 25019 Country: India Title: When will be the rakat missed behind immam?? after Surah Fatiha Or Before one tasbeih " Subhana Rabi Al azeem" Question: When will be the rakat missed behind immam?? after Surah Fatiha Or Before one tasbeih " Subhana Rabi Al azeem" Answer ID: 25019 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1408/1408/M=1431) If he attended imam in the ruku for a while i.e. before imam raised his head, then he will considered to perform the rukn with imam and the rakat will be counted; otherwise that rakat would be considered missed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
